# Summary

Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter. [[cite:obs-ac44b9ba46f1536e0f3fa15a2541984c00f2d739 "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]]

Ordinary contributions: one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January. [[cite:obs-b91be66b6bb574270b5ee007e3243363a2ffa6b6 "Ordinary contributions: one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January."]]

The charter states that the committee meets on the first Tuesday of the month. [[cite:obs-ac44b9ba46f1536e0f3fa15a2541984c00f2d739 "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]]

(The charter's exact meeting day is ambiguous in the notes, so no other meeting day is stated here.)
